note: DFM is a post-fit model reference, not independent truth. Camera calibration image-estimated; head location is a DFM-derived simulated fixed calibration.
bad_frame_rule: Either wrist in baseline, published gating, wrist-only, or cross-hand gating at 500 or 1500 steps has Euclidean difference >= 5 cm in a DFM-valid test frame.
